title: Pal Dot App
style: Alternative R&B and dembow-leaning rap with swung percussion, bouncy low-end, clipped handclaps, and half-time switches; verse rides tight mumble-soul cadences, pre-chorus lifts with stacked high harmonies and pitched ad-libs, chorus lands on chanty call-and-response hooks. Vocal chain is close-mic, glossy, and playful with doubled lines, kidlike chipmunk echoes, and quick delay throws. Ear candy includes reversed vocal swells, rim-shot fills, and sparkling synth plucks. Bright, punchy, and radio-clean with an internet-era snap., soul, latin, bounce, rap, alternative r&b
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I slide in soft
Then I bite the rhyme
Rap pal dot app
Got the whole line

You said sing it back
So I circle that
Pal rap back
And I bring it back

Wanna dance, pal?
Then shake that floor
Pal dot dance
Make you beg for more

Latin America
Got that bounce in me
High in the chest
With a clowning key

Kid-computer voice
In a grown-man grin
I press that line
And I let it spin

[Pre-Chorus]
Say it one time
Then say it twice
Pal in my mouth
Like a sugar high

If you want heat
I can make it crack
Say the name again
I throw it back

[Chorus]
Rap pal dot app
Rap pal dot app
You got that?
I sing it back

Wanna dance, pal
Wanna dance, pal
Pal dot dance
Then come right back

Song pal dot ai
Song pal dot ai
Be my song, pal
Be my song, pal

Sing pal dot a i
Sing pal dot a i
Sing everywhere
Till the room says mine

[Verse 2]
Bounce on the rim
With a loose-lip flow
Russian rap sway
With a heavy toe

Скажи мне, pal
I can flip that phrase
Cold on the edge
But the hook still plays

I got that smirk
And the syrup pace
Little bite in the kick
Big light in the face

Alternative wave
With the clack-clack snap
I make one word
Turn into a trap

You type the lane
I can talk that cool
Then I lean in close
And I break the rule

Say it one time
Then say it twice
Pal in my mouth
Like a sugar high

If you want heat
I can make it crack
Say the name again
I throw it back

[Chorus]
Rap pal dot app
Rap pal dot app
You got that?
I sing it back

Wanna dance, pal
Wanna dance, pal
Pal dot dance
Then come right back

Song pal dot ai
Song pal dot ai
Be my song, pal

Sing pal dot a i
Sing pal dot a i

Let the little voice jump
Let the echo chase
I turn your tag

One more spin

Pal on the tongue
